methodology: Two cloud SSE viewers; separately fetch and parse logged-out Ontario raw sources on the observer Mac. These observer reads are validation only; no prices are sent into the cloud app. Compare every quoted outcome, with up to three bounded raw attempts.
limits: HTTP observations are asynchronous. Report unresolved changes as mismatches, not proof of a scraper error. Full-game/overtime checks use recognized raw market types and explicit period metadata; house participation/early-exit settlement policies are not proven identical. This is not an update-latency benchmark.
